About.Title: An independent view of your wealth
Content: Ridger is a digital-first multi-family office based in Geneva. We support families in consolidating, monitoring and coordinating their wealth, without ever managing their assets in place of their banks and managers.
Our independence is the condition for an objective view. We have no product to place and no transaction to prompt; our only mission is to give you a clear picture and coordinate your advisors.

We begin with an audit of your existing setup, then put in place consolidated reporting and a rhythm of oversight suited to your priorities. You keep control of decisions; we prepare and follow up on them.
Confidentiality and discretion guide everything we do. Your data is hosted in Switzerland and shared only with the people you designate.

Quality.Title: Fee transparency
Quality.Content: We make the explicit and implicit fees of your banking relationships legible, for a full understanding of what your wealth costs.

Innovation.Title: A digital method
Innovation.Content: Continuous consolidation, a digital vault and controlled sharing: our digital-first workflows save time without ever compromising on security.
